digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Wednesday, August 19, with nine meetings, two urgent items, and six carry-overs. The day turns on closing the incident-trigger owner map before Thursday's BCP meeting, locking the SCV/FirstFire path toward the new September 18 go-live target, and resolving the noon Legal walkthrough conflict before a continuous leadership stack. Use Danny's quarterly skip-level and the EPMO discussion with Deepak to surface the decisions and dependencies that still lack owners or dates. The repository state snapshot is nearly two days old, so carry-over reflects the latest available dashboard state.

items.label: Consolidate the incident-trigger owner map
items.detail: Owner submissions were due yesterday and the next BCP meeting is Thursday. Combine each trigger, notification owner, and communication path today, then follow up on any missing bucket response.

items.label: Lock the SCV and FirstFire go-live path
items.detail: Jenn's updated plan targets UAT sign-off and go-live by September 18, while downstream production-readiness dates and the production quota status remain unclear. Confirm the integrated schedule, funding and sign-offs, and the CloudWatch monitoring decisions before the timeline moves again.

items.label: Date the VAWA Post-21 production launch
items.detail: Admin and acceptance-criteria updates landed yesterday. Confirm the mistreatment-question visibility, final UAT approval, and any intake-process impact, then publish the deployment date.

items.label: Close the Re-Open Cases SOP and handoff path
items.detail: This has remained open since August 13 and has a decision-alignment meeting Thursday. Confirm Leo's feedback date and settle the contractual, financial, and handoff questions before that meeting.

items.label: Set the Security Technology Launch path
items.detail: Confirm the Workplace Services and IT scoping group, sponsor path, first milestone, and Salt Lake City deployment sequence needed before the end of September.

items.label: Terminar Hoja de Jorge
items.detail: This has remained open since August 10. Finish the outstanding inputs in the morning focus window or name the dependency preventing closure.

items.label: 8:00-10:00 AM - Primary focus window
items.detail: Use the only clean two-hour block to consolidate incident triggers, finish Jorge's sheet, and frame the SCV decisions before meetings begin.

items.label: 10:00 AM-noon - Legal, Thiago, and Astrid
items.detail: Legal Change Management flows directly into Thiago and Astrid 1:1s, with only a 30-minute gap before noon. Carry a short owner-and-dependency list through all three conversations.

items.label: Noon-1:30 PM - Resolve the Legal walkthrough conflict
items.detail: Repository and intake-form walkthrough Session 3 overlaps the full Blocked Space hold. Choose the priority or delegate coverage before the session starts.

items.label: 1:30-5:00 PM - Skip-level and leadership stack
items.detail: Danny's quarterly skip-level leads directly into the EPMO meeting on Deepak's new SDLC process, a 30-minute prep block, Laura, CoE, and Sara. Capture decisions in real time because there is no recovery gap.

items.label: Resolve the noon Legal walkthrough conflict
items.detail: Decide whether to attend Repository and Intake Form Walkthrough Session 3 or protect the existing blocked time, and arrange coverage for the path not taken.

items.label: Complete LeadUp Module 3A
items.detail: Rippling lists Leading with a Growth Mindset as due Friday, August 21. Use a protected block today or tomorrow so it does not become another overdue training item.

items.label: 10:00 AM-noon - Amazon Connect, Armando, and a three-way conflict
items.detail: Amazon Connect training starts at 10:00 AM, followed by Armando at 11:00 AM. At noon, Legal Guidance training and Amazon Connect overlap a blocked-space hold; settle coverage today.

items.label: 1:30-5:00 PM - Re-Open Cases conflicts with BCP
items.detail: Re-Open Cases decision alignment and the BCP/Incident Response meeting occupy the same 1:30 PM slot, followed by SMS Automation, MHE, and the weekly team meeting. Decide which meeting owns the priority and send the other context in advance.
